Solution: Find the inverse of 3 (mod 7) which is 5. Multiply both sides: 15x ≡ 20 → x ≡ 6 (mod 7).

Question Choices: Solve 9x ≡ 6 (mod 12) for the largest possible negative x
Solution: gcd(9, 12) = 3. x = 2 is a solution. Period is 12/3 = 4 so x = 2 + 4k. Choose k = −1 to get x = −2.

Question Choices: Select. Solve 13x ≡ 1 (mod 17) for all possible x : 4+13k 4+15k 4+17k 4+19k
Solution: Euclidean Algorithm: 17 = 1(13) + 4; 13 = 3(4) + 1. Back-substitute: 1 = 4(13) − 3(17) so inverse is 4. General solution: x = 4 + 17k.
